facts.text: Sit by me, Elphie. I've ordered for both of us, and before you argue, yes, I picked the fancy dessert.
facts.why: On Welcome Day the two clash as roommates, and she is still Galinda until the Emerald City. 'Elphie' only appears after they bond at the Ozdust. A friendly note signed Glinda does not fit the day on the sign.
facts.fix: Roommate, sit by me. I've ordered for both of us, and before you argue, yes, I picked the fancy dessert.

fix_note.text: Roommate, sit by me. I've ordered for both of us, and before you argue, yes, I picked the fancy dessert.

facts.text: the dining hall at Shiz University
facts.why: The transcript has no dining hall, lunch or canteen scene at Shiz; the film's Shiz scenes are the classroom, library and the Ozdust dance.
facts.fix: the dance at the Ozdust Ballroom

facts.text: The train to the Emerald City
facts.why: The transcript has the train whistle, a conductor calling 'All aboard for the Emerald City' and an announcer for Emerald City Station, and Wikipedia mentions a life-size train carrying Elphaba and Glinda there.
facts.fix: The road to the Emerald City

vibe.verdict: Pink and green food works, but the school dining hall is a weak venue for a film that is all Ozdust, Defying Gravity and Emerald City.
